The '''''Alpha''-class heavy transport''' was a 400-meter-long [[Starship/Legends|starship]], used for both cargo and passenger [[Transport/Legends|transport]], that was manufactured before [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]] by [[Corellia StarDrive]].<ref name="SWA:HTSR">''[[Star Wars Adventures 1: Hunt the Sun Runner]]''</ref>

One such transport, named the ''[[Sun Runner]]'', was used as a [[Colony ship/Legends|colony ship]] around 4000 BBY by the [[Margrave Octan]], who transported his family and 867 other colonists from the [[Darpa sector/Legends|Darpa Sector]] to the [[Fondor]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nallastia]], in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]].<ref name="SWA:HTSR" />
